title.zh: 卷二十八 本紀第二十八 高宗五
title.raw: 卷二十八 本紀第二十八 高宗五 Volume 28 Annals 28: Gaozong 5

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, yisi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 5, spring, yisi new moon: the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 帝在平江府。

translations.literal: The Emperor was at Pingjiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong held court at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 金人去濠州。

translations.literal: The Jin withdrew from Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin left Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，戒諸軍戰陳毋殺中原民籍充金兵者。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the armies were admonished that in battle array they must not kill Central Plain civilians enrolled as Jin soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, every army was warned: in the line of battle, do not kill Central Plain men pressed into Jin ranks.

sentences.zh: 命鬻官田宅輸錢專充軍費。

translations.literal: An order sold official fields and houses for cash devoted solely to military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: The court sold official land and houses; the coin went only to the war chest.

sentences.zh: 戊申，進廬、泰二州守禦官屬各一官。

translations.literal: Day wushen: defenders of Lu and Tai prefectures each advanced one rank in staff.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Lu and Tai garrison staffs each rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔前宰執呂頤浩等十九人及行在職事官各條上攻戰備禦措置綏懷之策。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered the nineteen former chief ministers including Lü Yihao and mobile-court duty officers each to set forth policies for attack, defense, and soothing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, nineteen former ministers led by Lü Yihao and every mobile-court officer were told to lay out plans for war, defense, and pacification.

sentences.zh: 免淮南官吏去職之罪，仍令還任。

translations.literal: Huainan officials who had left office were pardoned and ordered back to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan men who had fled office were forgiven and sent back.

sentences.zh: 承州水砦統領仲諒復入楚州。

translations.literal: Chuzhou water-stockade commander Zhong Liang re-entered Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chuzhou water-stockade chief Zhong Liang marched back into Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張俊遣統領楊忠閔、王進夾擊金人於淮南岸，敗之，降其將程師回、張延壽。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhang Jun sent commanders Yang Zhongmin and Wang Jin to strike the Jin on both sides of the Huai shore; they routed them and the generals Cheng Shihui and Zhang Yanshou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Jun sent Yang Zhongmin and Wang Jin to pinch the Jin along the Huai; they broke them, and Cheng Shihui and Zhang Yanshou came over.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，淮東統制崔德明襲敗金兵於盱眙。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Huaidong controller Cui Deming raided and defeated Jin troops at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Huaidong controller Cui Deming ambushed the Jin at Xuyi and beat them.

sentences.zh: 召張浚赴行在。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，浚入見。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Zhang Jun was received.

sentences.zh: 賞沿江監司、帥臣供億之勞，各進官一等。

translations.literal: Surveillance commissioners and circuit defenders along the river who had supplied the court were each advanced one rank for their labor.
translations.idiomatic: River-route surveillance commissioners and defenders who had fed the court each rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 戊午，趣修建康行宮。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: construction of the Jiankang mobile palace was hurried.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, work on the Jiankang mobile palace was rushed.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔減淮南諸州雜犯死罪，釋流以下囚。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict reduced capital crimes among miscellaneous offenses in Huainan prefectures and freed prisoners below exile.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Huainan miscellaneous capital sentences were cut and everyone below exile was released.

sentences.zh: 庚申，置諸州軍教場，選兵專習弓弩，立格按試。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: drill grounds were set in every prefecture and army; picked troops trained in crossbows alone, with graded examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, every prefecture and army got a drill ground; picked men trained only in the crossbow, with graded trials.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，贈殿中侍御史馬伸左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Palace Attendant Censor Ma Shen was posthumously made Left Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Ma Shen of the palace censorate was posthumously made Left Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠、劉光世、張俊入見。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong, Liu Guangshi, and Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong, Liu Guangshi, and Zhang Jun were received.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以世忠為少保、淮東宣撫使，駐鎮江；

translations.literal: Day renxu: Han Shizhong was made Junior Guardian and Huaidong pacification commissioner, stationed at Zhenjiang;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Han Shizhong became Junior Guardian and Huaidong pacification commissioner at Zhenjiang;

sentences.zh: 光世少保、淮西宣撫使，駐太平；

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi Junior Guardian and Huai west pacification commissioner, stationed at Taiping;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi Junior Guardian and Huai west pacification commissioner at Taiping;

sentences.zh: 俊開府儀同三司、江東宣撫使，駐建康。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun Opening-Folder Parity with Triple Grandees and Jiangdong pacification commissioner, stationed at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun Opening-Folder Parity with Triple Grandees and Jiangdong pacification commissioner at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，酈瓊復光州，降其守許約。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Li Qiong recovered Guang prefecture and its defender Xu Yue surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Qiong retook Guang; defender Xu Yue bowed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷淮南茶鹽提刑司，置提點兩路公事官一員，兼領刑獄、茶鹽、漕運、市易事。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Huainan tea-and-salt surveillance office was abolished; one official for the two circuits' general affairs was set, concurrently overseeing law, tea, salt, transport, and market trade.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Huainan tea-and-salt surveillance was folded into one two-circuit general-affairs officer with law, tea, salt, transport, and market trade.

sentences.zh: 淮西要會州軍並置市易務。

translations.literal: Key prefectures and armies of Huai west all established market-trade offices.
translations.idiomatic: Every Huai west choke-point prefecture and army opened a market-trade office.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔川、陝宣撫司招諭陷賊官民。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict ordered the Chuan-Shaan pacification office to summon surrendered officials and people from occupied territory.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Chuan-Shaan pacification was told to win back officials and people under the enemy.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命王進合江西、廣東諸將兵討周十隆。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Wang Jin was ordered to unite Jiangxi and Guangdong generals to suppress Zhou Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang Jin was told to join Jiangxi and Guangdong generals against Zhou Shilong.

sentences.zh: 海賊朱聰犯廣州，又犯泉州。

translations.literal: Sea bandit Zhu Cong raided Guangzhou, then raided Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sea bandit Zhu Cong struck Guangzhou, then Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，劉光世、韓世忠、張俊入辭，命升殿，以光世、世忠有隙，賜酒諭釋之，皆感激奉詔。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Liu Guangshi, Han Shizhong, and Zhang Jun took leave; they were summoned to ascend the hall; because Guangshi and Shizhong were at odds, wine was bestowed to reconcile them, and all gratefully received the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Liu Guangshi, Han Shizhong, and Zhang Jun took leave and were called up the hall; wine was poured to heal the rift between Guangshi and Shizhong, and all went out grateful.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，偽齊知亳州馬秦犯光州，權州事王萃率兵拒之。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: puppet Qi Bozhou prefect Ma Qin raided Guang; acting prefect Wang Cui led troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, puppet Qi Bozhou prefect Ma Qin hit Guang; acting prefect Wang Cui met him with arms.

sentences.zh: 是月，金主晟殂，旻之孫亶立。

translations.literal: That month, Jin ruler Shen died; Min's grandson Dan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin emperor Shen died; Min's grandson Dan took the throne.

sentences.zh: 岳飛自池州入朝。

translations.literal: Yue Fei came to court from Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei entered court from Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，以飛為鎮寧、崇信軍節度使。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingzi: Yue Fei was made military commissioner of Zhenning and Chongxin armies.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingzi: Yue Fei became commissioner of Zhenning and Chongxin armies.

sentences.zh: 命常州布衣陳得一造新曆。

translations.literal: Changzhou commoner Chen Deyi was ordered to make a new calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou commoner Chen Deyi was told to draft a new calendar.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝發平江。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the Emperor set out from Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Gaozong left Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣權太常少卿張銖奉迎太廟神主於溫州。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Acting Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Zhu was sent to welcome the ancestral tablets from Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Acting Vice Minister Zhang Zhu went to bring the ancestral tablets from Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，帝至臨安，進扈從官吏秩一等。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Emperor reached Lin'an; escort officials were each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the court reached Lin'an; every escort officer rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以趙鼎為左僕射，張浚右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼知樞密院事、都督諸路軍馬。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhao Ding was made Left Vice Grand Councilor and Zhang Jun Right Vice Grand Councilor, both Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery with concurrent Privy Council affairs and overall command of all routes' armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhao Ding became Left Vice Grand Councilor and Zhang Jun Right Vice Grand Councilor, both Secretariat-Chancellery grand councilors with Privy Council and command of all routes.

sentences.zh: 岳飛為荊湖南北、襄陽府路制置使，將兵平湖賊楊太。

translations.literal: Yue Fei was made commissioner for Jing-Hu south and north and Xiangyang prefecture route, leading troops to level lake bandit Yang Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei was made commissioner of Jing-Hu south and north and Xiangyang route and marched to crush lake bandit Yang Tai.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，吳璘、楊政攻拔秦州，執偽齊守胡宣，金帥撒離曷來援，政復擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wu Lin and Yang Zheng stormed and took Qin prefecture, seized puppet Qi defender Hu Xuan; Jin commander Saliyehe came to rescue and Zheng again defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wu Lin and Yang Zheng stormed Qin and took puppet Qi defender Hu Xuan; Saliyehe came down and Zheng beat him again.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔建太廟。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict ordered construction of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the court ordered the ancestral temple built.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命張浚詣江上措置邊防，詔諭諸路宣撫制置司，示以專任之旨。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Zhang Jun was ordered to the river front to arrange border defense; edict-letters to every route pacification and control office showed the intent of sole responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhang Jun went to the river line to set the border; edict-letters to every pacification office named him sole master of defense.

sentences.zh: 以右司諫趙霈論奏得體，賜三品服。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrator Zhao Pei was rewarded with third-rank robes for measured memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator Zhao Pei won third-rank robes for measured memorials.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，進執政官秩一等，以賞防秋之功。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: chief ministers were each advanced one rank to reward autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, chief ministers each rose one grade for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔淮南宣撫司撫司淮北來歸官吏軍民。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: an edict ordered the Huainan pacification office to soothe officials, soldiers, and people coming from north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Huainan pacification was told to settle officials, soldiers, and people crossing from north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 己亥，直史館范冲上《神宗實錄考異》。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Academician of the Direct Historiography Fan Chong presented Examination of Differences in the Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Fan Chong of the historiography academy presented Examination of Differences in Shenzong's Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔翰林學士孫近、胡交修類編臣僚條具利害章疏以聞。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: an edict ordered Hanlin academicians Sun Jin and Hu Jiaoxiu to classify ministers' memorials on benefit and harm for report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Hanlin academicians Sun Jin and Hu Jiaoxiu were told to sort ministers' memorials on gain and loss for the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，蠲湖南路上供三年。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Hunan circuit's three years of tribute to the capital was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Hunan's three years of capital tribute were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，偽齊商元寇信陽軍，守臣舒繼明被禽，死之。

translations.literal: That month, puppet Qi Shang Yuan raided Xinyang army; defender Shu Jiming was captured and died.
translations.idiomatic: That month puppet Qi's Shang Yuan struck Xinyang army; defender Shu Jiming was taken and died.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙巳朔，雨雹。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, yisi new moon: hail fell with rain.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, yisi new moon: rain fell with hail.

sentences.zh: 丁未，胡松年罷。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Hu Songnian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Hu Songnian left office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，雪。

translations.literal: Day wushen: snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 己酉，留四川上供銀帛就充軍費。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Sichuan's silver and silks sent up were retained for military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Sichuan tribute silver and silk were kept on the circuit for the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以孟庾、沈與求並兼權樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Meng Yu and Shen Yuyou were both made acting Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Meng Yu and Shen Yuyou both took acting Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，並諸路提舉常平入茶鹽司。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: circuit granary commissioners were merged into the tea-and-salt offices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, every circuit granary office was folded into tea and salt.

sentences.zh: 罷福建鑄錢，令轉運、坑冶司辦集。

translations.literal: Fujian coin casting was halted; transport and mining offices were to gather supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian minting stopped; transport and mining offices were to supply coin.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，撒離曷欲犯秦州，吳玠遣部將牛皓伺之，遇於瓦五穀，戰死。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Saliyehe meant to strike Qin; Wu Jie sent subordinate Niu Hao to watch him; they met at Wawugu and Hao died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Saliyehe moved on Qin; Wu Jie sent Niu Hao to watch; at Wawugu Hao met him and fell.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，海賊陳感犯雷州，官軍屢敗。

translations.literal: Day guihai: sea bandit Chen Gan raided Leizhou; government troops were repeatedly beaten.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, sea bandit Chen Gan struck Leizhou; government troops lost again and again.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，王𤫉罢。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wang Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wang Yan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 命戶部尚書章誼措置財用，孟庾提領，號總制司。

translations.literal: Revenue Minister Zhang Yi was ordered to arrange finances; Meng Yu was put in charge, titled the General Control Office.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Minister Zhang Yi was told to settle finances under Meng Yu's General Control Office.

sentences.zh: 命川、陝宣撫司幕僚攝司事，仍權節制軍馬。

translations.literal: Chuan-Shaan pacification staff were ordered to act in office affairs and were also given temporary command of armies.
translations.idiomatic: Chuan-Shaan pacification staff were told to run the office and were given temporary army command.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置路分總管，以處閑退武臣。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: route overall commanders were set to place idle military officers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, route overall commanders were set for retired military men.

sentences.zh: 辛未，復置宗正丞，掌修屬籍。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the Directorate of the Imperial Clan was restored to keep the lineage registers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the clan directorate was restored to keep the registers.

sentences.zh: 再蠲荊南府、歸、峽二州、荊門、公安二軍歲貢上供二年。

translations.literal: Jingnan superior prefecture, Gui and Xia two prefectures, Jingmen and Gong'an two armies again had two years of annual tribute remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jingnan, Gui, Xia, Jingmen, and Gong'an again won two years off their capital tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌朔，以王𤫉貪縱不武，敗師誤國，責授濠州團練使。

translations.literal: Third month, jiaxu new moon: because Wang Yan was greedy, lax, and unwarlike, defeated the army and harmed the state, he was demoted to Haozhou militia training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiaxu new moon: Wang Yan, greedy and slack in war, was stripped to Haozhou militia training commissioner for defeat and harm to the state.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣樞密計議官呂用中等分使兩浙、江東、西路檢察經、總制司財用。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Privy Council planning officers Lü Yongzhong and others were sent in turn to inspect finances of the economic and general control offices on the two Zhes, Jiangdong, and Jiangxi west.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Privy Council planners Lü Yongzhong and others were sent to audit the economic and general control offices across Zhe, Jiangdong, and Jiangxi west.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔侍從至監察御史、館職已上，在內館職、在外侍從官、監司、帥守，各舉所知充監司、守令，尋命館職專舉縣令。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict ordered attendants through surveillance censors and academy posts upward, inner academy posts and outer attendants, surveillance commissioners, and defenders each to recommend the capable for surveillance and magistrate posts; soon academy posts were to recommend county magistrates alone.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, attendants through censors and academy men, inner and outer attendants, commissioners, and defenders were each to name men fit for surveillance and magistracy; soon academy men alone were to name county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以韓世忠兼鎮江府宣撫使，劉光世兼太平州宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Han Shizhong was made concurrent Zhenjiang pacification commissioner; Liu Guangshi concurrent Taiping pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Han Shizhong took Zhenjiang pacification and Liu Guangshi Taiping pacification.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以都督府參議軍事邵溥兼權川、陝宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Overall Command staff planning officer Shao Pu was made acting Chuan-Shaan pacification vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Overall Command planner Shao Pu became acting Chuan-Shaan pacification vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 罷御前軍器所提舉官，並隸工部。

translations.literal: The Imperial Front Armory superintendent was abolished; it was placed under the Works Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Front Armory superintendent was cut; the Works Ministry took it.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命廣東、福建路招捕朱聰。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Guangdong and Fujian were ordered to recruit and capture Zhu Cong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Guangdong and Fujian were told to hunt Zhu Cong.

sentences.zh: 乙未，初榷鉛、錫。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: lead and tin were first monopolized.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, lead and tin were first placed under state monopoly.

sentences.zh: 張浚親討湖賊。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun personally campaigned against the lake bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun took the field himself against the lake bandits.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，復移浙西安撫司于臨安府。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Zhe west soothing office was again moved to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Zhe west soothing office returned to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷饒州牧馬監。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Raozhou horse pasture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Raozhou horse pasture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，貴池縣丞黃大本坐枉法贓，杖脊、刺配南雄州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingwu: Guichi county aide Huang Daben, for corrupt judgment and bribes, was beaten at the spine and tattooed to Nanxiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingwu: Guichi aide Huang Daben, corrupt in judgment and bribes, was flogged at the spine and tattooed to Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣司農丞蓋諒持詔撫諭川、陝。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Agriculture Commissioner Gai Liang was sent with an edict to soothe Chuan and Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Agriculture Commissioner Gai Liang carried an edict to soothe Chuan and Shaan.

sentences.zh: 召解潛赴行在，王彥知荊南府，諸鎮撫使至是盡罷。

translations.literal: Xie Qian was summoned to the mobile court; Wang Yan became Jingnan prefect; all route soothing commissioners were abolished at this time.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Qian was recalled; Wang Yan became Jingnan prefect; every route soothing commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太廟神主至自溫州。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the ancestral tablets arrived from Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the ancestral tablets came from Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以審量濫賞，追左銀青光祿大夫王序八官及職名，仍改正出身。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: on review of excessive rewards, Left Silver-Gleam Grandee Wang Xu was stripped of eight ranks and titles and his origin degree was corrected.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, reviewing lavish rewards, Left Silver-Gleam Grandee Wang Xu lost eight ranks and titles and had his origin corrected.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔內侍遇特恩轉宮，止武功郎。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict said when eunuchs received special favor promotions, they stopped at Military Merit Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, eunuchs promoted by special favor were capped at Military Merit Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 壬子，訪得周後柴叔夏襲封崇義公。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Later Zhou heir Chai Shuxia was found and enfeoffed Duke of Chongyi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Later Zhou heir Chai Shuxia was found and made Duke of Chongyi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，奉安太廟神主。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the ancestral tablets were installed in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the ancestral tablets were installed.

sentences.zh: 己未，更免役保正長法。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the law on exemption-service village heads was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the law on exemption-service village heads was revised.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太上皇帝崩于五國城。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Retired Emperor died at Wuguo City.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Huizong died at Wuguo City in Jin captivity.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，帝即射殿行朝獻景靈宮之禮，始以惠恭皇后祔祭。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Emperor performed at the Archery Hall the court offering to the Jingling Palace; for the first time Empress Huigong was joined in the side sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Gaozong offered at the Archery Hall to Jingling Palace; for the first time Empress Huigong shared the side altar.

sentences.zh: 募民耕營田，官給牛、種。

translations.literal: The people were recruited to farm garrison fields; the state gave oxen and seed.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners were called to farm garrison fields; the state gave oxen and seed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，省四川添差官。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Sichuan supernumerary posts were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Sichuan supernumerary posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以諸路稅賦畸零增收錢專充上供。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: odd fractional tax surcharges on every route were devoted solely to capital tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, odd fractional tax surcharges on every route went only to capital tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，龍圖閣直學士致仕楊時卒。

translations.literal: That month, retired Dragon Diagram direct academician Yang Shi died.
translations.idiomatic: That month retired Dragon Diagram academician Yang Shi died.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，初謁太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yihai: the ancestral temple was first visited.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yihai: Gaozong first visited the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命邵溥、吳玠裁省四川冗官浮費。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Shao Pu and Wu Jie were ordered to cut Sichuan's redundant officials and waste.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Shao Pu and Wu Jie were told to cut Sichuan's redundant men and waste.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，名行宮新作書院為資善堂。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the mobile palace's new academy was named Zishan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the mobile palace's new academy was named Zishan Hall.

sentences.zh: 遣何蘚等奉使金國，通問二帝。

translations.literal: He Xian and others were sent as envoys to the Jin state to inquire after the two emperors.
translations.idiomatic: He Xian and others were sent to the Jin to ask after the two captive emperors.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人胡寅言，國家與金世仇，無通使之義。

translations.literal: Drafting Attendant Hu Yin said the state and the Jin were hereditary foes and there was no justification for sending envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Attendant Hu Yin said Song and Jin were blood enemies and envoys had no place.

sentences.zh: 張浚奏：「使事兵家機權，後將辟地復土，終歸於和，未可遽絕。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun memorialized: "Envoys are military expedient; later we will widen territory and recover soil, and in the end return to peace—it cannot yet be cut off abruptly."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun wrote: "Envoys are a soldier's trick; later we widen land and take back soil, and peace comes at last—the road cannot be shut yet."

sentences.zh: 」乃遣行。

translations.literal: They were then sent.
translations.idiomatic: The embassy went out anyway.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立殘破州縣守令勸民墾田及拋荒殿最格。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: standards were set to rank magistrates of ruined prefectures and counties by urging the people to reclaim fields and by abandoned land.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, magistrates of ruined prefectures and counties were graded by reclaimed fields and abandoned land urged back to the plow.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以孟庾知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Meng Yu was made Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Meng Yu became Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，召張浚還行在。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Zhang Jun was recalled to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhang Jun was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔浚提舉詳定一司敕令。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict ordered Zhang Jun to oversee detailed revision of the One-Office Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhang Jun was told to oversee revision of the One-Office Statutes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以貴州防禦使瑗為保慶軍節度使，封建國公。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Guizhou defense commissioner Yuan was made Baoqing army military commissioner and enfeoffed Duke of Jianguo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Guizhou defender Yuan became Baoqing commissioner and Duke of Jianguo.

sentences.zh: 徽猷閣待制范冲兼資善堂翊善，起居郎朱震兼贊讀。

translations.literal: Huixian Hall attendant Fan Chong was made Zishan Hall companion; Attendant Diarist Zhu Zhen was made reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Huixian attendant Fan Chong became Zishan companion; Attendant Diarist Zhu Zhen became reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 以盛暑，命監司行部慮囚。

translations.literal: Because of great heat, surveillance commissioners were ordered to tour circuits and review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the heat, surveillance commissioners were told to tour and review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己亥，岳飛軍次鼎州。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Yue Fei's army halted at Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Yue Fei camped at Ding.

sentences.zh: 庚子，周十隆降。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhou Shilong surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhou Shilong surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命川、陝訪求元祐黨人子孫。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Chuan and Shaan were ordered to seek descendants of Yuanyou faction members.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Chuan and Shaan were told to find Yuanyou faction descendants.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，封武經大夫令矼為安定郡王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: Military Classic Grandee Ling Jiang was enfeoffed Prince of Anding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: Military Classic Grandee Ling Jiang was made Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 湖賊楊欽、全琮、劉詵相繼率眾詣岳飛降。

translations.literal: Lake bandits Yang Qin, Quan Cong, and Liu Shen in succession led their masses to surrender to Yue Fei.
translations.idiomatic: Lake bandits Yang Qin, Quan Cong, and Liu Shen came over to Yue Fei one after another.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，名新曆曰《統元》。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the new calendar was named Tongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the new calendar was named Tongyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，並饒州鑄錢司於虔州。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Raozhou mint was merged into Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Raozhou mint was folded into Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命建國公瑗出就資善堂聽讀，拜范沖、朱震。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Duke of Jianguo Yuan was ordered out to hear lectures at Zishan Hall and bowed to Fan Chong and Zhu Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Duke of Jianguo Yuan went out to Zishan Hall, heard lecture, and bowed to Fan Chong and Zhu Zhen.

sentences.zh: 出內帑錢賜宗室貧者。

translations.literal: Inner-palace funds were issued to aid poor clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-palace coin was given to poor clansmen.

sentences.zh: 壬子，復省淮南州縣冗官。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Huainan prefectures and counties again had redundant officials reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Huainan prefectures and counties again cut redundant posts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以久旱，減膳、祈禱。

translations.literal: Day guichou: because of long drought, meals were reduced and prayers offered.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, long drought brought reduced meals and prayer.

sentences.zh: 禁諸路科率，自租稅、和市、軍須外皆罷。

translations.literal: Every route's exactions were forbidden; beyond rent tax, harmonized purchase, and army needs, all were halted.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit exactions were banned; beyond rent, harmonized purchase, and army needs, every levy stopped.

sentences.zh: 岳飛急攻湖賊水砦，賊將陳瑫降，楊太赴水死，餘黨劉衡等皆降。

translations.literal: Yue Fei stormed the lake bandits' water stockade; bandit general Chen Tan surrendered; Yang Tai drowned himself; the rest such as Liu Heng all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei stormed the lake bandits' water fort; Chen Tan surrendered; Yang Tai drowned; Liu Heng and the rest came in.

sentences.zh: 飛急擊夏誠，斬之。

translations.literal: Fei at once attacked Xia Cheng and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Fei at once struck Xia Cheng and took his head.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，湖賊黃誠斬楊太首，挾鐘子儀、周倫詣都督府降，湖湘悉平，得戶二萬七千，悉遣歸業。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: lake bandit Huang Cheng beheaded Yang Tai's head, brought Zhong Ziyi and Zhou Lun to the Overall Command to surrender; lake and Xiang were all pacified; twenty-seven thousand households were gained and all were sent back to their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Huang Cheng sent Yang Tai's head and brought Zhong Ziyi and Zhou Lun to the Overall Command; lake and Xiang were pacified; twenty-seven thousand households were returned to the plow.

sentences.zh: 戊午，減福建貢茶歲額之半。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Fujian tribute tea was cut by half for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Fujian tribute tea for the year was halved.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以旱罷諸路檢察財用官。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: because of drought, every route's finance inspectors were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, drought abolished every route's finance inspectors.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以賊平，免沿湖民前二年逋租。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: because the bandits were pacified, lakeside people's arrears of two years' rent were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, with the bandits down, lakeside arrears of two years' rent were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己巳，罷福建諸州槍杖手。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Fujian prefectures' spear-and-staff militia were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Fujian spear-and-staff militia were abolished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申朔，以仇悆為沿海制置使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renshen new moon: Qiu Kui was made coastal control commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen new moon: Qiu Kui became coastal control commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免蘄州上供及租稅三年。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Qizhou capital tribute and rent tax were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Qizhou capital tribute and rent were remitted three years.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，獎諭岳飛，撫勞將士，趣張浚還朝。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Yue Fei was rewarded and soldiers soothed; Zhang Jun was urged to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Yue Fei was rewarded and his men soothed; Zhang Jun was urged back to court.

sentences.zh: 己卯，孟庾罷，以沈與求兼權樞密院事及措置財用。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Meng Yu was dismissed; Shen Yuyou was made acting Privy Council affairs and finance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Meng Yu left; Shen Yuyou took acting Privy Council affairs and finance.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以金、均、房州隸襄陽府路。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Jin, Jun, and Fang prefectures were placed under Xiangyang route.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Jin, Jun, and Fang were placed under Xiangyang route.

sentences.zh: 偽齊兵寇湖陽縣，執唐州守臣高青，復釋之。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi troops raided Huyang county, seized Tang prefecture defender Gao Qing, then released him.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi raided Huyang, seized Tang defender Gao Qing, then let him go.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜宇文虛中家福建田十頃。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: ten qing of Fujian fields were bestowed on Yuwen Xuzhong's family.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, ten qing of Fujian land were given to Yuwen Xuzhong's kin.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔殘破州縣親民官，計到、罷之日戶口考殿最。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict said magistrates of ruined prefectures and counties who were close to the people would be graded by households at arrival and departure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, magistrates of ruined places who lived among the people were to be graded by households when they came and went.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠復鎮淮軍，禽偽齊守王拱。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong again garrisoned Zhenhuai army and captured puppet Qi defender Wang Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong again held Zhenhuai army and took puppet Qi defender Wang Gong.

sentences.zh: 丙申，蠲湖南路上供米三年及秋租之半。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Hunan route's three years of tribute grain and half the autumn rent were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Hunan's three years of tribute grain and half the autumn rent were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，置高峰、王口二砦都巡檢使，益兵戍之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Gaofeng and Wangkou two stockades were given overall patrol commissioners; garrison troops were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Gaofeng and Wangkou stockades got patrol commissioners and more garrison men.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅朔，罷荊南營田司，令安撫司措置官兵耕種。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renyin new moon: the Jingnan garrison-farm office was abolished; the soothing office was to arrange officers and soldiers for farming.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin new moon: Jingnan garrison-farm office was cut; the soothing office was to set officers and men to the plow.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，定館職額為十八員。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: academy posts were fixed at eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, academy posts were fixed at eighteen.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔淮南山水砦都巡檢各聽守令節制。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict said Huainan mountain-and-water stockade patrol commissioners each obeyed magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Huainan mountain-and-water stockade patrols were put under magistrates.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，蠲福建州軍供撥常平錢米。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Fujian prefectures and armies had granary support money and grain remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Fujian prefectures and armies were remitted granary support money and grain.

sentences.zh: 己未，下詔示章惇、蔡卞詆誣宣仁聖烈皇后之罪，追貶惇昭化軍節度副使，卞單州團練副使，子孫不許在朝。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict exposed Zhang Dun and Cai Bian's crime in slandering Empress Xuanren; Dun was demoted to Zhaohua army vice commissioner, Bian to Danzhou militia vice commissioner; their descendants were forbidden at court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the court exposed Zhang Dun and Cai Bian for slandering Empress Xuanren; Dun fell to Zhaohua vice commissioner, Bian to Danzhou militia vice commissioner; their lines were barred from court.

sentences.zh: 命廣宮學，教內外宗子。

translations.literal: The palace academy was expanded to teach inner and outer clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: The palace academy was widened to teach inner and outer clansmen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔淮南、襄陽府等路團結民社。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: an edict ordered Huainan, Xiangyang, and other routes to organize civilian militia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Huainan, Xiangyang, and other routes were told to organize civilian militia.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以諸盜平，減湖、廣、江西二十二州雜犯死罪，釋徒、杖以下囚。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: because all bandits were pacified, capital crimes among miscellaneous offenses in twenty-two Hu, Guang, and Jiangxi prefectures were reduced and convicts below hard labor and beating were freed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, with bandits down, capital crimes in twenty-two Hu, Guang, and Jiangxi prefectures were cut and men below hard labor and beating were freed.

sentences.zh: 海賊朱聰降，命補水軍統領。

translations.literal: Sea bandit Zhu Cong surrendered and was appointed naval commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sea bandit Zhu Cong surrendered and was made naval commander.

sentences.zh: 是月，偽齊陷光州。

translations.literal: That month, puppet Qi took Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month puppet Qi took Guang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未朔，罷總制司所增收頭子等諸色錢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinwei new moon: the General Control Office's added head-tax and other levies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinwei new moon: the General Control Office's added head-tax and other levies were cut.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜禮部進士汪洋以下二百二十人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day yihai: two hundred twenty Ministry of Rites advanced scholars including Wang Yang and below were given jinshi and origin degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, two hundred twenty Ministry of Rites graduates led by Wang Yang received jinshi and origin.

sentences.zh: 唱名始遵故典，令館職侍立殿上。

translations.literal: Calling names first followed the old statute; academy posts and attendants stood in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Calling names followed the old rite; academy men and attendants stood in the hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，加岳飛檢校少保。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Yue Fei was given acting Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yue Fei was made acting Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 偽齊兵寇固始縣，統領華旺拒戰，卻之，尋復光州。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi troops raided Gushi county; commander Hua Wang fought them off and they withdrew; soon Guang was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi raided Gushi; commander Hua Wang beat them back; soon Guang was retaken.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命沿海州軍籍海舶，分守要害。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: coastal prefectures and armies were ordered to register sea ships and divide defense of key points.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, coastal prefectures and armies were told to register sea ships and hold the choke points.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，趙鼎上《重修神宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zhao Ding presented the Revised Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhao Ding presented the Revised Veritable Records of Shenzong.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔元符上書邪等範柔中等二十七人各官一子。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict said twenty-seven men of the Yuanyou faction including Fan Rouzhong each had one son given office.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, twenty-seven Yuanyou men led by Fan Rouzhong each had one son given office.

sentences.zh: 以解潛部兵三千隸馬軍司。

translations.literal: Three thousand of Xie Qian's troops were assigned to the Cavalry Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand of Xie Qian's men went to the Cavalry Bureau.

sentences.zh: 甲午，周十隆復叛，犯汀州。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Zhou Shilong rebelled again and raided Ting prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhou Shilong rose again and raided Ting.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣統領王進、李貴討之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: commanders Wang Jin and Li Gui were sent to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, commanders Wang Jin and Li Gui were sent after him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，張浚入見。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu: Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengxu: Zhang Jun was received.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以席益為四川制置大使，位宣撫副使上，州軍兵馬並隸大使司，邊防重事仍令宣撫司處置。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Xi Yi was made Sichuan control grand commissioner, ranking above pacification vice commissioner; prefectures and armies were all under the grand commissioner's office; major border affairs were still for the pacification office.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Xi Yi became Sichuan control grand commissioner above the pacification vice commissioner; every prefecture and army answered his office; grave border matters still went to pacification.

sentences.zh: 李綱為江西制置大使，呂頤浩為湖南制置大使。

translations.literal: Li Gang was Jiangxi control grand commissioner; Lü Yihao Hunan control grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang became Jiangxi control grand commissioner; Lü Yihao Hunan control grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔川、陝類試合格第一人依殿試第三人例推恩，餘並同賜進士出身，特奏名進士命宣撫選官試時務策。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: an edict said the first-ranked man passing the Chuan-Shaan classified examination received favor like the third palace-examination man; the rest all received jinshi origin like it; specially presented jinshi were examined on current affairs by the pacification office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Chuan-Shaan classified first place won favor like palace examination third; the rest took jinshi origin; specially presented men sat a current-affairs exam under pacification.

sentences.zh: 澧州賊雷德進降。

translations.literal: Li prefecture bandit Lei Dejin surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Li prefecture bandit Lei Dejin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，偽齊兵寇漣水軍，韓世忠遣統制呼延通等逆擊，敗之。

translations.literal: Day yichou: puppet Qi troops raided Lianshui army; Han Shizhong sent controllers Huyan Tong and others to meet them and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, puppet Qi raided Lianshui army; Han Shizhong sent Huyan Tong and others to meet them and broke them.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午朔，初置節度使以下金字牙符，命都督府掌之，給將帥立戰功者。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengwu new moon: gold-letter tally plaques below military commissioner were first set; the Overall Command was to keep them and give them to generals who established battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengwu new moon: gold-letter tallies below military commissioner were first forged; the Overall Command kept them for generals who won on the field.

sentences.zh: 命州縣賣戶帖以助軍費。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties were ordered to sell household registers to aid military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were told to sell household registers for the war chest.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔守臣死節昭著者，毋限品秩，並賜諡。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict said defenders who died with manifest loyalty were not limited by rank; all were given posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, defenders who died with clear loyalty were not capped by rank; all received posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，征和靖處士尹焞於涪州，命為崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Hermit Yin Tun of Hejing was summoned from Fuzhou and made lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Hejing hermit Yin Tun was summoned from Fuzhou and made Chongzheng Hall lecturer.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，郊。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the suburban sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復置淮南提舉鹽事官。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Huainan salt commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Huainan salt commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 壬午，出宮女三十人。

translations.literal: Day renwu: thirty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, thirty palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 甲申，權減宰執及行在官吏奉。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: chief ministers and mobile-court officials' salaries were temporarily reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, chief ministers and mobile-court salaries were cut for the moment.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以趙開為四川都轉運使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zhao Kai was made Sichuan overall transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhao Kai became Sichuan overall transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命張浚視師荊、襄、川、陝。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhang Jun was ordered to inspect armies at Jing, Xiang, Chuan, and Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhang Jun was told to inspect armies at Jing, Xiang, Chuan, and Shaan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知衡州裴廩坐調夫築城凍死二千餘人，除名、嶺南高州編管。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Heng prefecture magistrate Pei Lin, for drafting labor to build walls where more than two thousand froze to death, was struck from the rolls and assigned to Gaozhou registry control in Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Heng magistrate Pei Lin, whose wall-draft killed more than two thousand in the cold, was struck from the rolls and sent to Gaozhou registry control in Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，出內帑綿絹賜宗室。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: inner-palace silks were issued to clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, inner-palace silks were given to clansmen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷催稅戶長。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: tax-collection household heads were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, tax-collection household heads were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥朔，以岳飛為荊湖南北、襄陽府路、蘄黃州招討使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Yue Fei was made Jing-Hu south and north, Xiangyang route, and Qi-Huang pacification and suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Yue Fei became commissioner of Jing-Hu south and north, Xiangyang route, and Qi-Huang pacification.

sentences.zh: 楊沂中權主管殿前司，並統神武中軍。

translations.literal: Yang Yizhong was made acting head of the Palace Front Bureau and also commanded the Divine Martial central army.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yizhong took acting Palace Front Bureau and also commanded Divine Martial central army.

sentences.zh: 庚子，改神武四軍及巡衛軍號行營五護軍。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the four Divine Martial armies and patrol guards were renamed the Five Guards of the Mobile Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, four Divine Martial armies and patrol guards became the Five Guards of the Mobile Camp.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以都督府兵隸三衙。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Overall Command troops were placed under the Three Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Overall Command troops went under the Three Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 命左右司、樞密院檢詳官參考中興已行條例，修為定法。

translations.literal: Left and right secretariats and Privy Council review officers were ordered to consult enacted regulations since the Restoration and revise them as fixed law.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right secretariats and Privy Council reviewers were told to gather Restoration statutes into fixed law.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禁服用翠羽。

translations.literal: Day yisi: wearing kingfisher feathers was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, kingfisher feathers were forbidden in dress.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免侍從官輪對。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: attendants' turn at court memorial was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, attendants were excused their turn at court memorial.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，汰橫江水軍三之一。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: a third of the Hengjiang naval army was cut.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, a third of the Hengjiang navy was cut.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命兩淮、川陝、荊襄、荊南諸帥府參謀官各一員提點屯田。

translations.literal: Day guichou: each of the Huai two circuits, Chuan-Shaan, Jing-Xiang, and Jingnan command staffs was given one staff officer to oversee garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, each staff of Huai two circuits, Chuan-Shaan, Jing-Xiang, and Jingnan got one officer to oversee garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，禁川陝州縣官悉用川陝人。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Chuan-Shaan prefectures and counties were forbidden to use only Chuan-Shaan natives as officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Chuan-Shaan posts were forbidden to fill only with natives.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，都督府遣參議軍事劉子羽、主管機宜文字熊彥詩撫諭川陝，且察邊備虛實。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Overall Command sent planning officer Liu Ziyu and secretariat officer Xiong Yanshi to soothe Chuan-Shaan and also inspect border preparations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Overall Command sent Liu Ziyu and Xiong Yanshi to soothe Chuan-Shaan and probe the border's strength.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，夜雨雹。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: hail fell at night.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, hail fell in the night.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛未，蠲貧民戶帖錢之半，無物產者悉除之。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day xinwei: poor people's household-register fees were halved; those without property were wholly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 6, spring, xinwei: poor men's household-register fees were halved; men without property paid nothing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命給事中、中書舍人甄別元祐黨籍。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: remonstrators and drafting attendants were ordered to screen the Yuanyou faction register.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, remonstrators and drafting attendants were told to screen the Yuanyou faction register.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以內重外輕，命省台、寺監及監司、守令居職及二年者，許更迭出入除擢。

translations.literal: Day yihai: because inner was heavy and outer light, an edict said provincial, temple, and surveillance offices and magistrates and defenders who had served two years might rotate in and out for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, finding inner offices overweight and outer light, the court said provincial, temple, surveillance, magistrate, and defender posts of two years might rotate for promotion.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔凡入粟補官者，毋授親民、刑法之職。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: an edict said those who bought office with grain might not receive posts close to the people or penal law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, grain-buyers of office were barred from magistracies and penal posts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜宗子伯玖名琚，為和州防禦使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: clansman Bo Jiu was named Ju and made Hezhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, clansman Bo Jiu was named Ju and made Hezhou defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 罷綿州宣撫副使，命吳玠專治兵事。

translations.literal: Mianzhou pacification vice commissioner was abolished; Wu Jie was ordered to command troops alone.
translations.idiomatic: Mianzhou pacification vice commissioner was cut; Wu Jie alone commanded troops.

sentences.zh: 罷御史平反刑獄賞。

translations.literal: The censorate reward for reversing criminal cases was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate reward for reversing criminal cases was cut.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，張浚視師荊襄，入辭。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhang Jun inspected armies at Jing and Xiang and took leave.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhang Jun inspected Jing and Xiang armies and took leave.

sentences.zh: 己丑，安定郡王令矼薨。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Prince of Anding Ling Jiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Prince of Anding Ling Jiang died.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，還預借坊場錢。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: advance distillery franchise money was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, advance distillery franchise money was restored.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔監司、帥臣慢令失職者，令張浚黜陟以聞。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: an edict said surveillance commissioners and defenders who were slow with orders or failed in duty were to be promoted or demoted by Zhang Jun for report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, surveillance commissioners and defenders who lagged or failed were to rise or fall at Zhang Jun's word.

sentences.zh: 甲午，振江、湖、福建、浙東饑民，命監司、帥臣分選僚屬及提舉常平官躬行檢察。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Jiang, Hu, Fujian, and eastern Zhe famine people were relieved; surveillance commissioners and defenders were to choose subordinates and granary commissioners to inspect in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, famine in Jiang, Hu, Fujian, and eastern Zhe was relieved; commissioners and defenders were to send subordinates and granary men to inspect themselves.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命鬻通直郎、閣門宣贊舍人以下官。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Tongzhi Gentleman and below and Gate Proclamation Usher and below were ordered sold.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Tongzhi Gentleman down and Gate Proclamation Usher down were put up for sale.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，以諸路宣撫制置大使並兼營田大使，宣撫副使、招討安撫使並兼營田使。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi: every route pacification and control grand commissioner was also made garrison-farm grand commissioner; vice commissioners, pacification-suppression commissioners, and soothing commissioners were also made garrison-farm commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengzi: every route grand pacification commissioner also took garrison-farm grand commission; vice commissioners and pacification commissioners took garrison-farm commission too.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雨雪。

translations.literal: Day renyin: rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 改江、淮屯田為營田。

translations.literal: Yangtze and Huai garrison farms were changed to camp farms.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang and Huai garrison farms were renamed camp farms.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置行在交子務，印交子錢引給諸路，令公私同見錢行用。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: a mobile-court Jiaozi Office was set up to print jiaozi exchange notes for every route, ordering public and private use on par with visible cash.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, a mobile-court Jiaozi Office printed exchange notes for every route; public and private were to treat them like cash in hand.

sentences.zh: 戊申，岳飛入見。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Yue Fei had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yue Fei was received.

sentences.zh: 復以襄陽府路為京西南路。

translations.literal: Xiangyang prefecture circuit was again made Jing-southwest circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang circuit was restored as Jing southwest.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔張浚暫赴行在奏事。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: an edict ordered Zhang Jun to come temporarily to the mobile court to report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Jun was told to report at court for the moment.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以兵部尚書、都督府參謀折彥質簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: War Minister and Overall Command staff officer Zhe Yanzhi was made Privy Council signing officer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, War Minister and Overall Command staff officer Zhe Yanzhi signed at the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，韓世忠引兵攻宿遷縣，統制呼延通與金兵戰，敗之，禽其將孛堇牙合。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Han Shizhong led troops to attack Suqian county; controller Huyan Tong fought the Jin and routed them, capturing their general Bolian Yahe.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Han Shizhong struck Suqian; Huyan Tong met the Jin, broke them, and took Bolian Yahe.

sentences.zh: 澧州賊徒伍俊殺雷德進，持其首詣鼎州降。

translations.literal: Li prefecture bandit Wu Jun killed Lei Dejin, took his head, and went to Ding prefecture to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Li bandit Wu Jun killed Lei Dejin, carried his head to Ding, and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，韓世忠圍淮陽軍。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Han Shizhong besieged Huaiyang army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Han Shizhong besieged Huaiyang army.

sentences.zh: 復置諸路市易務。

translations.literal: Market offices on every route were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Market offices on every route were restored.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命楊沂中以兵萬人聽都督行府調遣。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Yang Yizhong was ordered with ten thousand troops to obey Overall Command dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yang Yizhong took ten thousand men under Overall Command orders.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣戶部侍郎劉甯止如鎮江府，總領三宣撫司錢糧。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Households Vice Minister Liu Ningzhi was sent to Zhenjiang to oversee funds and grain of the three pacification offices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Households Vice Minister Liu Ningzhi went to Zhenjiang to run money and grain for the three pacification offices.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，兀朮救淮陽，韓世忠引兵歸楚州。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Wuzhu relieved Huaiyang; Han Shizhong withdrew to Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Wuzhu relieved Huaiyang and Han Shizhong fell back to Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以折彥質兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zhe Yanzhi was made acting Vice Grand Councilor as well.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zhe Yanzhi was also made acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，沈與求罷。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Shen Yuqiu left office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Shen Yuqiu left office.

sentences.zh: 李綱入見。

translations.literal: Li Gang had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang was received.

sentences.zh: 是月，張浚至江上會諸將議事，命張俊進屯盱眙。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Jun reached the river to meet the generals for council and ordered Zhang Jun to advance camp at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Overall Command chief Zhang Jun met the generals on the river and sent Zhang Jun to camp at Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰朔，初收官告綾紙錢。

translations.literal: Third month, wuchen new moon: official silk-paper money was first collected.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuchen new moon: official silk-paper money was first taken in.

sentences.zh: 名金、均、房州民兵曰保勝，又命招刺三千人，賜名必勝軍。

translations.literal: Jin, Jun, and Fang prefecture militia were named Baosheng; three thousand more were recruited and given the name Bisheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: Jin, Jun, and Fang militia were called Baosheng; three thousand more were raised as the Bisheng Army.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以韓世忠為京東、淮東路宣撫處置使，岳飛為京西、湖北路宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Han Shizhong was made Jingdong and Huaidong-route pacification and disposition commissioner; Yue Fei was made Jingxi and Hubei-route pacification vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Han Shizhong became Jingdong and Huaidong pacification commissioner; Yue Fei became Jingxi and Hubei vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，蠲旱傷州縣民積欠錢帛租稅。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: arrears in money, silk, and tax from drought-struck prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, drought-hit counties were cleared of money, silk, and tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 己卯，趣岳飛如鄂州措置軍事。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Yue Fei was urged to Ezhou to arrange military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yue Fei was hurried to Ezhou for the armies.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以樞密副都承旨馬擴為沿海制置副使。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Privy Council deputy chief bearer Ma Kuo was made coastal control vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Privy Council deputy bearer Ma Kuo became coastal control vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，金、齊兵犯漣水軍，韓世忠擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Jin and Qi troops raided Lianshui army; Han Shizhong routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Jin and Qi raided Lianshui army; Han Shizhong beat them back.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，寬四川災傷州縣戶帖錢之半。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Sichuan disaster counties' household-register money was halved.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Sichuan disaster counties paid half the household-register levy.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，湖南賊黃旺犯桂陽監。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuxu new moon: Hunan bandit Huang Wang raided Guiyang stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuxu new moon: Hunan bandit Huang Wang hit Guiyang stockade.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，偽齊兵陷唐州，團練判官扈舉臣、推官張從之等皆死。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: puppet Qi troops took Tang prefecture; training judge Hu Juchen, registrar Zhang Congzhi, and the rest all died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, puppet Qi took Tang; training judge Hu Juchen, registrar Zhang Congzhi, and the rest died.

sentences.zh: 岳飛以母喪去官。

translations.literal: Yue Fei left office on his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei left office for his mother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔飛起復。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: an edict recalled Fei from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yue Fei was recalled from mourning.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔文武臣僚能決勝強敵恢復境土者，賜功臣號。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict said civil and military officials who could defeat a strong foe and recover territory would receive merit titles.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, officials who could beat a strong foe and win back land were promised merit titles.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，始訓諸宗子名。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: imperial clansmen were first instructed in naming.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, imperial clansmen were first taught naming.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賞淮陽功，呼延通等進官有差，餘受賞者凡萬七千人。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Huaiyang merit was rewarded; Huyan Tong and others were advanced in rank by degrees, and seventeen thousand more received reward.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Huaiyang merit was rewarded; Huyan Tong and others rose by steps, and seventeen thousand more were paid.

sentences.zh: 劉光世遣副統制王師晟、酈瓊襲偽齊兵于劉龍城，破之，禽其統制華知剛。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi sent deputy controllers Wang Shicheng and Li Qiong to strike puppet Qi at Liu Longcheng, broke them, and captured their controller Hua Zhigang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi sent Wang Shicheng and Li Qiong to hit puppet Qi at Liu Longcheng, broke them, and took Hua Zhigang.

sentences.zh: 己未，命福建安撫司發水軍討海賊鄭慶。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Fujian soothing office was ordered to send naval troops against sea bandit Zheng Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Fujian was told to send the navy after sea bandit Zheng Qing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禁四川伐並邊山林。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Sichuan was forbidden to cut frontier mountain forests.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Sichuan was forbidden to log frontier forests.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以韓世忠為橫海、武甯、安化軍節度使，號揚武翊運功臣。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Han Shizhong was made military commissioner of Transocean, Wuning, and Anhua armies, styled Merit Lord Yangwu Yiyun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Han Shizhong took Transocean, Wuning, and Anhua and was styled Merit Lord Yangwu Yiyun.

sentences.zh: 除商旅緡錢稅。

translations.literal: The merchant travel string-cash tax was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The merchant travel string-cash tax was cut.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，復行在官吏奉。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: mobile-court officials' salaries were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, mobile-court salaries were restored.

sentences.zh: 蠲東京民渡淮南商販之稅。

translations.literal: Tax on Eastern Capital people crossing the Huai to trade was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tax on Eastern Capital traders crossing the Huai was remitted.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰朔，禁以鹿胎為冠。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuchen new moon: hats of deer womb were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuchen new moon: deer-womb hats were banned.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔未經上殿臣僚，先令三省審察，然後引對。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict said officials not yet presented at court must first be vetted by the Three Departments, then led in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, officials not yet presented had to pass Three Departments review before audience.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以四川監司地遠玩法，應有違戾，令制置大使按劾。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: because Sichuan surveillance commissioners were far and treated the law lightly, violations were to be investigated by the control grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Sichuan commissioners who played loose with law were to be checked by the control grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔大理寺議獄不合，即詣刑部關決，刑部不能定，同赴都堂稟議。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict said when the Court of Judicial Review disagreed on a case it should go to the Ministry of Justice for decision; if Justice could not decide, both should report to the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Court of Judicial Review disputes went to Justice; if Justice stalled, both reported to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 賜吳玠四川戶帖錢十萬緡犒軍。

translations.literal: Wu Jie was given one hundred thousand strings of Sichuan household-register money to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie got one hundred thousand strings of Sichuan household money to reward troops.

sentences.zh: 癸未，禁淮南州縣收額外雜色租。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Huainan prefectures and counties were forbidden extra miscellaneous rents.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Huainan counties were forbidden extra miscellaneous rent.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改交子為關子，罷交子務。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: jiaozi was changed to guanzi and the Jiaozi Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, jiaozi became guanzi and the Jiaozi Office was shut.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以劉光世為保靜、甯武、甯國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Liu Guangshi was made military commissioner of Baojing, Ningwu, and Ningguo armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Guangshi took Baojing, Ningwu, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以張俊進屯盱眙，改崇信、奉甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day renchen: because Zhang Jun advanced camp at Xuyi, he was made military commissioner of Chongxin and Fengning armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhang Jun camped at Xuyi and was made Chongxin and Fengning military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禁銷錢及私鑄銅器。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: melting coin and private casting of copper vessels were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, melting coin and private copper casting were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔監司慮囚不能遍及者，聽遣官，著為令。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: an edict said if surveillance commissioners could not review prisoners everywhere, they might send officials; this was made a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, surveillance commissioners who could not reach every jail might send men; the rule was fixed.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳夜，地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yisi night: earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yisi night: the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，求直言。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: blunt counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, blunt counsel was sought.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，張浚渡江，撫淮上諸屯。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Zhang Jun crossed the river and soothed the Huai camps.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhang Jun crossed the river and inspected the Huai camps.

sentences.zh: 命劉光世自當塗進屯廬州，岳飛自九江進屯襄陽，楊沂中屯泗州。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi was ordered from Dangtu to camp at Luzhou; Yue Fei from Jiujiang to camp at Xiangyang; Yang Yizhong at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi was told from Dangtu to Luzhou; Yue Fei from Jiujiang to Xiangyang; Yang Yizhong to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔兩淮沿江守臣並以三年為任。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: an edict said defenders along both Huai and the Yangtze alike served three-year terms.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Huai and Yangtze defenders alike were given three-year terms.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，封集英殿修撰令懬為安定郡王。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Compiler of the Hall of Gathered Elegance Ling Huai was enfeoffed Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Hall of Gathered Elegance compiler Ling Huai was made Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，以司農少卿樊賓提領營田公事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renshen: Court of Imperial Granaries Vice Minister Fan Bin was put in charge of camp-farm affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: Granaries Vice Minister Fan Bin took camp-farm affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔張浚暫赴行在。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict ordered Zhang Jun to come temporarily to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Jun was told to court for the moment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷川陝便宜差遣監司、守貳。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Chuan-Shaan discretionary dispatch of surveillance commissioners and prefectural deputies was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Chuan-Shaan discretionary commissioner dispatch was cut.

sentences.zh: 以金州隸川陝路，均、房二州隸京西南路。

translations.literal: Jin prefecture was placed under Chuan-Shaan circuit; Jun and Fang under Jing-southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Jin went to Chuan-Shaan; Jun and Fang to Jing southwest.

sentences.zh: 郭浩為永興軍路經略安撫使兼知金州，閣門宣贊舍人邵隆知商州，聽浩節制，經理商、虢。

translations.literal: Guo Hao was made Yongxing army-route frontier commissioner and pacification commissioner with concurrent Jin prefecture; Gate Proclamation Usher Shao Long was made Shang prefecture magistrate under Hao's command to manage Shang and Guo.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hao became Yongxing frontier commissioner and pacification commissioner at Jin; Shao Long became Shang magistrate under him for Shang and Guo.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉光世復壽春府。

translations.literal: That month, Liu Guangshi recovered Shouchun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liu Guangshi took back Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，范宗尹薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai: Fan Zongyin died.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jihai: Fan Zongyin died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜左司諫陳公輔三品服。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Right Secretariat Remonstrator Chen Gongfu was given third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Right Secretariat Remonstrator Chen Gongfu received third-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以徽猷閣直學士李迨為四川都轉運使。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Palatine Hall direct academician Li Dai was made Sichuan overall transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Palatine Hall academician Li Dai became Sichuan overall transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔諭將士將親征。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: an edict told the armies the emperor would campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the armies were told the emperor would take the field.

sentences.zh: 岳飛遣統制牛皋破偽齊鎮汝軍，禽其守薛亨。

translations.literal: Yue Fei sent controller Niu Gao to break puppet Qi's Zhen Ru army and capture its defender Xue Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei sent Niu Gao to break puppet Qi at Zhen Ru and take defender Xue Heng.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命權殿前司解潛等帥精兵扈從，主管步軍司邊順留兵守臨安，知臨安府梁汝嘉為巡幸隨軍都轉運使。

translations.literal: Day yisi: acting Palace Front commander Xie Qian and others led picked troops as escort; Infantry Bureau chief Bian Shun kept men at Lin'an; Lin'an prefect Liang Rujia was made follow-campaign overall transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Xie Qian and others led picked escort troops; Bian Shun held Lin'an; Liang Rujia became follow-campaign transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以秦檜為醴泉觀使兼侍讀、行宮留守，孟庾提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀、同留守。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Qin Hui was made Liquan Abbey commissioner with concurrent Lecturer and mobile-palace keeper; Meng Geng was made Wanshou Abbey commissioner with concurrent Lecturer and associate keeper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Qin Hui became Liquan commissioner and Lecturer with palace keeping; Meng Geng Wanshou commissioner, Lecturer, and associate keeper.

sentences.zh: 戊申，岳飛遣將楊再興復西京長水縣。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Yue Fei sent general Yang Zaixing to recover Western Capital Changshui county.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yang Zaixing recovered Western Capital Changshui for Yue Fei.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命秦檜、孟庾權參決尚書省、樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Qin Hui and Meng Geng were given provisional voice in the Secretariat and Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Qin Hui and Meng Geng were given provisional voice in Secretariat and Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，蠲虔州殘破諸縣逋負、梅州夏秋兩稅，聽廣東經略安撫司便宜措置盜賊。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: arrears of ruined Gan prefecture counties were remitted and Meizhou spring and autumn taxes cut; Guangdong frontier commissioner was allowed discretionary action against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Gan arrears were cleared, Meizhou taxes cut, and Guangdong was allowed discretion against bandits.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，奉神主發臨安。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the spirit tablets set out from Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the spirit tablets left Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，權罷經筵進講。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: lectures at the Classics Colloquium were suspended for the moment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Classics Colloquium lectures were suspended.

sentences.zh: 己未，預借江、浙民來年夏稅絁帛，折米輸官。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Jiang and Zhe people were advanced next year's summer silk tax, to be paid in rice to the state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Jiang and Zhe paid next summer's silk levy early, in rice to the state.

sentences.zh: 庚申，增給職事官米月三斛。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: duty officials' monthly rice ration was raised by three piculs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, duty officials gained three piculs of rice a month.

sentences.zh: 是月，張俊城盱眙，進屯泗州。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Jun walled Xuyi and advanced camp to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Jun walled Xuyi and moved camp to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 岳飛及偽齊李成、孔彥舟連戰至蔡州，克之，偽守劉永壽舉城降。

translations.literal: Yue Fei fought puppet Qi's Li Cheng and Kong Yanzhou in succession to Cai prefecture, took it, and puppet defender Liu Yongshou surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei fought Li Cheng and Kong Yanzhou of puppet Qi to Cai, took it, and Liu Yongshou surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，帝發臨安。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingyin new moon: the emperor set out from Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingyin new moon: the emperor left Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 岳飛遣統制王貴、郝晸、董先復虢州盧氏縣。

translations.literal: Yue Fei sent controllers Wang Gui, Hao Zheng, and Dong Xian to recover Guo prefecture Lushi county.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei sent Wang Gui, Hao Zheng, and Dong Xian to recover Guo's Lushi county.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，帝次平江。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the emperor stopped at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the emperor halted at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命職事官日一員輪對。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: one duty official a day was ordered to rotate in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, one duty official a day was to rotate in audience.

sentences.zh: 壬午，岳飛以孤軍無援，復還鄂州。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Yue Fei, as a lone army without support, returned again to Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yue Fei, unsupported, fell back again to Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，權奉安神主於平江能仁寺。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the spirit tablets were provisionally lodged at Pingjiang's Nengren Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the spirit tablets were lodged at Pingjiang's Nengren Monastery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以戶部郎官霍蠡總領岳飛軍錢糧。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Households Bureau officer Huo Li was put in overall charge of Yue Fei's army funds and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Huo Li took overall charge of Yue Fei's funds and grain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，張浚入奏，復如鎮江。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Zhang Jun reported in audience and returned to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zhang Jun reported and went back to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立賊徒相招首罪賞格。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a reward schedule for bandits who induced one another to surrender was set.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, rewards were fixed for bandits who turned one another in.

sentences.zh: 賞鎮淮軍功，進統制王德等官。

translations.literal: Zhen-Huai army merit was rewarded; controller Wang De and others were advanced.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen-Huai merit was rewarded; Wang De and others rose in rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉豫聞親征，告急于金主亶求援，亶不許，豫自起兵三十萬，命子麟趣合肥，侄猊出渦口，引兵分道入寇。

translations.literal: That month, hearing of the personal campaign, Liu Yu urgently begged Jin ruler Dan for aid; Dan refused; Yu himself raised three hundred thousand, ordered his son Lin toward Hefei and nephew Ni out from Wokou, and led troops in separate columns to invade.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liu Yu heard of the personal campaign, begged Jin ruler Dan in vain, raised three hundred thousand himself, sent Lin on Hefei and Ni from Wokou, and invaded in columns.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，招西北流寓人補闕額禁軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen: northwest refugees were recruited to fill guard-army quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingshen: northwest refugees filled guard-army quotas.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，裁定淮南路租額。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Huainan south-route rent quotas were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Huainan south rent quotas were fixed.

sentences.zh: 劉麟寇淮西，張俊遣楊沂中、張宗顏等分兵禦之。

translations.literal: Liu Lin raided Huai west; Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong and Zhang Zongyan and others in divided forces to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lin hit Huai west; Zhang Jun sent Yang Yizhong and Zhang Zongyan in divided columns.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，沂中至濠州，劉光世已棄廬州而南，浚遣人督還，光世不得已駐兵應沂中，遣統制王德、酈瓊及賊將崔皋、賈澤、王遇戰，皆敗之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Yizhong reached Haozhou; Liu Guangshi had already abandoned Luzhou and gone south; Jun sent men to press him back; Guangshi had no choice but to camp and answer Yizhong; he sent controllers Wang De and Li Qiong and defectors Cui Gao, Jia Ze, and Wang Yu to battle and routed them all.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yizhong reached Haozhou; Guangshi had fled Luzhou south until Jun drove him back; Wang De, Li Qiong, Cui Gao, Jia Ze, and Wang Yu fought and broke every column.

sentences.zh: 賊兵攻壽春府芍陂砦，守臣孫暉拒戰，又敗之。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked Shouchun's Shaobo stockade; defender Sun Hui met them in battle and routed them again.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels hit Shouchun's Shaobo stockade; Sun Hui met them and broke them again.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，罷四川監酒官百餘員。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: more than a hundred Sichuan wine supervisors were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, more than a hundred Sichuan wine supervisors were cut.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以梁汝嘉兼浙西、淮東沿海制置使，前護副軍都統制王彥副之。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Liang Rujia was made concurrent Zhe west and Huaidong coastal control commissioner; former deputy overall commander of the Rear Guard Wang Yan was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Liang Rujai became Zhe west and Huaidong coastal commissioner; Rear Guard deputy Wang Yan served under him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，趙鼎請降敕諭張浚，令光世、沂中及張俊全軍引還，為防江之計。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhao Ding asked that an edict be sent down to Zhang Jun telling Guangshi, Yizhong, and Zhang Jun to draw the whole army back for river defense.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhao Ding asked an edict through Overall Command chief Zhang Jun to pull Guangshi, Yizhong, and Zhang Jun the general back for river defense.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，又詔浚督將士僇力破賊，皆未達。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: another edict pressed Jun to drive the armies to break the foe with all their strength; neither reached him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, another edict pressed Jun to break the foe with full force; neither reached him.

sentences.zh: 劉猊犯定遠縣，沂中進戰，大敗之於藕塘，猊挺身遁，麟在順昌聞之，拔砦去。

translations.literal: Liu Ni raided Dingyuan county; Yizhong advanced to fight and routed him greatly at Outang; Ni fled bodily; hearing it at Shunchang, Lin pulled up stockades and left.
