translations.idiomatic: Liu Ni raided Dingyuan; Yizhong met him at Outang and broke him utterly; Ni ran; at Shunchang Lin heard it and broke camp.

sentences.zh: 劉光世遣王德及沂中追麟，至南壽春而還。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi sent Wang De and Yizhong to pursue Lin; they reached South Shouchun and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi sent Wang De and Yizhong after Lin to South Shouchun and turned back.

sentences.zh: 孔彥舟亦解光州圍而去。

translations.literal: Kong Yanzhou also lifted the siege of Guang prefecture and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yanzhou also raised the siege of Guang and left.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命解潛遣兵千人守青龍港口。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Xie Qian was ordered to send a thousand troops to guard Qinglong harbor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Xie Qian was told to post a thousand men at Qinglong harbor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，張俊、楊沂中引兵攻壽春府，不克而還。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhang Jun and Yang Yizhong led troops to attack Shouchun prefecture, failed to take it, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhang Jun and Yang Yizhong struck Shouchun, failed, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸軍所俘人民給錢米遣歸。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict ordered captives from every army given money and grain and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, every army's captives were given money and grain and sent home.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，惠州軍賊曾袞作亂。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Huizhou army bandit Zeng Gun rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Huizhou bandit Zeng Gun rose.

sentences.zh: 庚申，摧鋒軍統制韓京募敢死士，夜襲破之，袞尋出降。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Vanguard Army controller Han Jing recruited dare-to-die men and by night raid broke them; Gun soon came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Vanguard controller Han Jing's night raid broke them; Gun soon surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，日中有黑子沒。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the black spot in the sun vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the sun's black spot vanished.

sentences.zh: 十二月申午朔，詔降廬、光、濠等州死罪，釋流以下囚。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiawu new moon: an edict reduced capital crimes in Lu, Guang, Hao, and other prefectures and freed prisoners below exile.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiawu new moon: Lu, Guang, Hao, and the rest cut capital crimes and freed men below exile.

sentences.zh: 召秦檜赴行在。

translations.literal: Qin Hui was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 張浚入見，請幸建康；

translations.literal: Zhang Jun had audience and asked to move the seat to Jiankang;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was received and asked to move the seat to Jiankang;

sentences.zh: 趙鼎請還臨安。

translations.literal: Zhao Ding asked to return to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding asked to return to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，韓世忠攻淮陽軍，及金人戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Han Shizhong attacked Huaiyang army, fought the Jin, and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Han Shizhong struck Huaiyang army, met the Jin, and broke them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，城南壽春府。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the south of Shouchun prefecture was walled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the south of Shouchun was walled.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，趙鼎罷。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zhao Ding left office.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhao Ding left office.

sentences.zh: 遣右司員外郎范直方宣諭川、陝，撫問吳玠將士。

translations.literal: Right Secretariat staff officer Fan Zhifang was sent as envoy to Chuan and Shaan to soothe and inquire of Wu Jie's armies.
translations.idiomatic: Right Secretariat officer Fan Zhifang was sent to Chuan and Shaan to soothe Wu Jie's men.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命都督府參議軍事呂祉如建康，措置移蹕。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Overall Command staff officer Lü Zhe was sent to Jiankang to arrange moving the imperial progress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Overall Command staff officer Lü Zhe went to Jiankang to arrange the move of court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，折彥質罷。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhe Yanzhi left office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhe Yanzhi left office.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賞淮西功，加張俊少保，改鎮洮、崇信、奉甯軍節度使，楊沂中保成軍節度使、殿前都虞候。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Huai-west merit was rewarded; Zhang Jun was made Junior Mentor, military commissioner of Zhentao, Chongxin, and Fengning armies; Yang Yizhong Baocheng military commissioner and Palace Front chief adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Huai-west merit was paid; Zhang Jun became Junior Mentor and Zhentao, Chongxin, and Fengning commissioner; Yang Yizhong Baocheng commissioner and Palace Front adjutant.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命秦檜赴講筵供職，孟庾為行宮留守。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Qin Hui was ordered to the lecture service; Meng Geng was mobile-palace keeper.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Qin Hui took the lecture service; Meng Geng kept the mobile palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以資政殿學士張守參知政事，兼權樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Zhang Shou was made Vice Grand Councilor with concurrent acting Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Shou became Vice Grand Councilor with acting Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以呂頤浩為浙撫西安制置大使、判臨安府。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Lü Yihao was made Zhe pacification and Xi'an control grand commissioner with concurrent Lin'an prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Lü Yihao became Zhe pacification and Xi'an control grand commissioner and Lin'an prefect.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以劉光世為護國、鎮安、保靜軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Liu Guangshi was made military commissioner of Huguo, Zhen'an, and Baojing armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Liu Guangshi took Huguo, Zhen'an, and Baojing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔凡因民事被罪者，不許親民。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: an edict said anyone punished for civil cases might not hold office among the people.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, anyone punished in civil cases was barred from magistracy among the people.

sentences.zh: 己未，命辰、沅、靖、澧四州以閒田募刀弩手，三千五百人為額。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Chen, Yuan, Jing, and Li four prefectures were ordered to recruit crossbowmen from idle land, quota thirty-five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Chen, Yuan, Jing, and Li were told to raise thirty-five hundred crossbowmen from idle land.

sentences.zh: 右司諫陳公輔乞禁程氏學。

translations.literal: Right Secretariat Remonstrator Chen Gongfu asked to ban the Cheng school.
translations.idiomatic: Right Secretariat Remonstrator Chen Gongfu asked to ban the Cheng school.

sentences.zh: 詔：「士大夫之學宜以孔、孟為師，庶幾言行相稱，可濟時用。

translations.literal: Edict: "The learning of scholar-officials should take Confucius and Mencius as teachers, so that words and conduct may match and serve the time."
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Scholar-officials should take Confucius and Mencius as teachers, so word and deed match and meet the age."

sentences.zh: 」庚申，以安化郡王王稟死節太原，賜其家田十頃。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: because Prince of Anhua Wang Bing died loyal at Taiyuan, his household was given ten qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Prince of Anhua Wang Bing died loyal at Taiyuan; his house got ten qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以山陰、諸暨等四十縣為大邑，並命堂除。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Shanyin, Zhuji, and forty other counties were made great counties, all with hall appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Shanyin, Zhuji, and forty counties became great counties with hall appointment.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸亥朔，帝在平江，下詔移蹕建康。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, guihai new moon: the emperor was at Pingjiang and issued an edict to move court to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, spring, guihai new moon: at Pingjiang, the emperor ordered court to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 蠲無為軍稅役一年。

translations.literal: Wuwei army tax and corvée were remitted one year.
translations.idiomatic: Wuwei army tax and corvée were remitted one year.

sentences.zh: 置建康御前軍器局。

translations.literal: A Jiankang imperial front armory was set up.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiankang imperial front armory was set up.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賞張浚以破敵功，遷特進。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zhang Jun was rewarded for breaking the enemy and promoted Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhang Jun was rewarded for breaking the foe and made Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 己巳，發米萬石濟京東、陝西來歸之民。

translations.literal: Day jisi: ten thousand piculs of rice were sent to relieve people returning from Jingdong and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, ten thousand piculs of rice fed returnees from Jingdong and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 張浚入見。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was received.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷都督府諸州市易官。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Overall Command market officials in every prefecture were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Overall Command market officials in every prefecture were cut.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，解潛罷，以劉錡權主管馬軍司，並殿前步軍司公事。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Xie Qian left office; Liu Qi was made acting chief of the Cavalry Bureau with concurrent Palace Front and Infantry Bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Xie Qian left; Liu Qi took acting Cavalry Bureau chief with Palace Front and Infantry affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，築採石、宣化渡二城。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Caishi and Xuanhua crossing forts were built.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Caishi and Xuanhua crossing forts were built.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以翰林學士陳與義參知政事，資政殿學士沈與求同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Hanlin academician Chen Yuyi was made Vice Grand Councilor; Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Shen Yuqiu Associate Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Chen Yuyi became Vice Grand Councilor; Shen Yuqiu Associate Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 詔廣西帥臣訓練土丁、保丁。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Guangxi circuit defenders to train native levies and baoding militia.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi defenders were told to train native levies and baoding militia.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，復置樞密使、副，知院以下仍舊，張浚改兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Privy Councilor and Vice Councilor were restored; knowers of the council and below remained as before; Zhang Jun was changed to concurrent Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Privy Councilor and Vice were restored; Zhang Jun became concurrent Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁諸軍互納亡卒。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: armies were forbidden to take in one another's deserters.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, armies were forbidden to shelter one another's deserters.

sentences.zh: 西蕃三十八族首領趙繼忠等來歸。

translations.literal: Thirty-eight Western Tibetan tribe chiefs led by Zhao Jizhong came over.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-eight Western Tibetan chiefs led by Zhao Jizhong came over.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以秦檜為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Qin Hui was made Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Qin Hui became Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 何蘚、范寧之至自金國，始聞上皇及甯德皇后崩。

translations.literal: He Xian and Fan Ningzhi arrived from the Jin state; only then was it learned the retired emperor and Empress Ningde had died.
translations.idiomatic: He Xian and Fan Ningzhi came from Jin; only then was the retired emperor's and Empress Ningde's death learned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝成服，下詔降徒囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the emperor put on mourning garments; an edict reduced penal servitude and freed those below the cane.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the emperor donned mourning; penal servitude was cut and men below the cane freed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯夜，東北有赤氣如火。

translations.literal: Xinmao night: in the northeast there was red vapor like fire.
translations.idiomatic: Xinmao night: red vapor like fire rose in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, guisi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guisi new moon: the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 百官七上表，請遵以日易月之制。

translations.literal: The hundred officials memorialized seven times asking to follow the day-for-month mourning rule.
translations.idiomatic: Officials seven times asked the day-for-month mourning rule.

sentences.zh: 徽猷閣待制、知嚴州胡寅請服喪三年，衣墨臨戎，以化天下。

translations.literal: Palatine Hall awaiting appointment and Yan prefecture magistrate Hu Yin asked to observe three years' mourning, wear black, and take command in war to transform the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Palatine Hall awaiting appointment Hu Yin of Yan asked three years' mourning, black dress in war, to transform the realm.

sentences.zh: 帝欲遂終服，而張浚連疏論喪服不可即戎，遂詔外朝勉從所請，宮中仍行三年之喪。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to finish mourning, but Zhang Jun in successive memorials argued mourning dress could not immediately take the field; an edict then said the outer court should reluctantly follow the request while the palace still kept three years' mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wanted full mourning, but Zhang Jun argued one could not fight in mourning dress; the outer court was pressed to comply while the palace kept three years.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太平州火。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Taizhou caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Taizhou burned.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鎮江府火。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Zhenjiang prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhenjiang burned.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣王倫等使金國迎奉梓宮。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Wang Lun and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to welcome the imperial coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wang Lun and others went to Jin to welcome the coffin.

sentences.zh: 岳飛入見。

translations.literal: Yue Fei had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei was received.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以日食，求直言；

translations.literal: Day xinchou: because of the eclipse, blunt counsel was sought;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the eclipse brought a call for blunt counsel;

sentences.zh: 以久旱，命諸州慮囚。

translations.literal: because of long drought, every prefecture was ordered to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: long drought ordered every prefecture to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔凡辟舉官犯贓罪，罪及所舉官。

translations.literal: Day yisi: an edict said when a recommended official committed bribery, the recommender was punished as well.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, bribery by a recommended man reached the recommender too.

sentences.zh: 丙午，吳玠置銀會子於河池。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wu Jie set up silver exchange notes at Hechi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wu Jie set up silver notes at Hechi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔席益募陝西、河東、河北兵二千，部送行在充扈衛。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: an edict ordered Xi Yi to recruit two thousand soldiers from Shaanxi, Hedong, and Hebei and escort them to court as guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Xi Yi was told to raise two thousand from Shaanxi, Hedong, and Hebei for court guard.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day guichou: hail.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，始禦便殿。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the emperor first held court in the informal hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the emperor first held court in the informal hall.

sentences.zh: 果州守臣宇文彬等進《禾登九穗圖》，俱奪一官，罷之。

translations.literal: Guo prefecture magistrate Yuwen Bin and others presented a "Nine-Ears on One Stalk" picture; all were demoted one rank and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Guo magistrate Yuwen Bin and others presented a Nine-Ears picture; all lost a rank and were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以岳飛為太尉、湖北京西宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Yue Fei was made Grand Marshal and Huguang Jingxi pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Yue Fei became Grand Marshal and Huguang Jingxi pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，帝發平江。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the emperor set out from Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the emperor left Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥朔，次丹陽，韓世忠入見，命世忠扈從，岳飛次之。

translations.literal: Third month, guihai new moon: he stopped at Danyang; Han Shizhong had audience and was ordered to escort; Yue Fei was second.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guihai new moon: at Danyang, Han Shizhong was received as escort; Yue Fei followed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次鎮江，楊沂中入見，命沂中總領彈壓巡幸事務。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: he stopped at Zhenjiang; Yang Yizhong had audience and was ordered to take overall charge of escort security.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, at Zhenjiang, Yang Yizhong was received to command escort security.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，蠲駐蹕及經從州縣積年逋賦。

translations.literal: Day yichou: arrears of years of tax from halting and transit counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, years of tax arrears on the route were cleared.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以吏部侍郎呂祉為兵部尚書、都督府參謀軍事。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Personnel Vice Minister Lü Zhe was made War Minister and Overall Command staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Personnel Vice Minister Lü Zhe became War Minister and Overall Command staff officer.

sentences.zh: 辛未，帝至建康。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the emperor reached Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the emperor reached Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔尚書省常程事從參知政事分治。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict said routine Secretariat business was divided among Vice Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, routine Secretariat work was split among Vice Grand Councilors.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，減建康流罪以下囚，蠲建康府、太平、宣州逋賦及下戶今年身丁錢。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Jiankang prisoners below exile were reduced; arrears of Jiankang, Taiping, and Xuan prefectures and this year's body-tax money for lower households were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Jiankang prisoners below exile were cut; Jiankang, Taiping, and Xuan arrears and lower-household body tax were cleared.

sentences.zh: 岳飛乞並統淮西兵以復京畿、陝右，許之，命飛盡護王德等諸將軍。

translations.literal: Yue Fei asked to unite Huai-west troops to recover the capital region and Shaan right; it was granted, and he was ordered to command Wang De and the other generals entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei asked to merge Huai-west troops for the capital and Shaan right; it was granted and he was to command Wang De and all generals.

sentences.zh: 既而秦檜等以合兵為疑，事遂寢。

translations.literal: Soon Qin Hui and others doubted merging armies, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Qin Hui and others doubted merging armies, and the matter died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，手詔撫勞將士。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: a hand edict soothed and rewarded the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a hand edict soothed the armies.

sentences.zh: 進沈與求知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Shen Yuqiu was advanced to Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yuqiu was advanced to Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，尊宣和皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Xuanhe Empress was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Xuanhe Empress was honored as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以王彥兵隸侍衛馬軍司。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Wang Yan's troops were placed under the Palace Horse Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Yan's men went to the Palace Horse Guard.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩為少保兼行宮留守。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao was made Junior Mentor with concurrent mobile-palace keeping.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao became Junior Mentor and mobile-palace keeper.

sentences.zh: 孟庾罷。

translations.literal: Meng Geng left office.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Geng left office.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以劉光世為少師、萬壽觀使，以其兵隸都督府，張浚因分為六軍，命呂祉節制。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Liu Guangshi was made Junior Mentor and Wanshou Abbey commissioner; his troops were placed under the Overall Command; Zhang Jun divided them into six armies and ordered Lü Zhe to control them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Liu Guangshi became Junior Mentor and Wanshou commissioner; his troops went to the Overall Command; Zhang Jun split six armies under Lü Zhe.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜光世第于建康府。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Guangshi was given a mansion in Jiankang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Guangshi was given a Jiankang mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命虔、吉、南安軍諸縣各募土兵百人，責知縣訓練，防禦盜賊。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Qian, Ji, and Nan'an army counties were each ordered to recruit a hundred native soldiers; magistrates were charged to train them against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Qian, Ji, and Nan'an counties each raised a hundred native soldiers; magistrates trained them against bandits.

sentences.zh: 是春，廣西大饑，李實變為桃。

translations.literal: That spring, Guangxi suffered great famine; plums turned into peaches.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Guangxi starved; plums turned into peaches.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，築太廟于建康，以臨安府太廟為聖祖殿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi: the Grand Temple was built at Jiankang; Lin'an's Grand Temple became the Sacred Ancestor Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guisi: the Grand Temple rose at Jiankang; Lin'an's temple became the Sacred Ancestor Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，修浚建康城池。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Jiankang walls and moat were repaired and dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Jiankang walls and moat were repaired and dredged.

sentences.zh: 丁未，岳飛乞解官持餘服，遂棄軍去，詔不許。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Yue Fei asked to leave office and keep the remainder of mourning; he then abandoned the army and left; an edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yue Fei asked leave for the rest of mourning, then quit the army; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 戊申，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day wushen: there was a black spot in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, a black spot appeared in the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以張浚累陳岳飛積慮專在並兵，奏牘求去，意在要君，遂命兵部侍郎兼都督府參議軍事張宗元權湖北、京西宣撫判官，實監其軍。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: because Zhang Jun repeatedly wrote that Yue Fei's constant worry was solely over merging armies and his memorials begging to leave aimed to coerce the ruler, War Vice Minister and Overall Command staff officer Zhang Zongyuan was made acting Huguang Jingxi pacification judge to supervise the army in fact.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Jun wrote that Yue Fei's aim was merged armies and resignation to coerce the throne; Zhang Zongyuan was made acting Huguang Jingxi judge to watch the army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，張浚如太平州、淮西視師。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Zhang Jun went to Taizhou and Huai west to inspect the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Zhang Jun inspected armies at Taizhou and Huai west.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以信陽軍隸京西路。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Xinyang army was placed under Jing west circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xinyang army went to Jing west.

sentences.zh: 罷淮南提點司，東西兩路各置轉運兼提點刑獄、提舉茶鹽常平事。

translations.literal: The Huainan intendant office was abolished; east and west routes each got transport with concurrent judicial intendant and tea-salt and ever-normal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan intendant was cut; east and west each got transport with judicial, tea-salt, and ever-normal duties.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，詔李綱趣捕虔、吉諸盜。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingmao: an edict urged Li Gang to hurry against Qian and Ji bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingmao: Li Gang was urged against Qian and Ji bandits.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命禮官舉文宣王、武成王、熒惑、壽星、岳鎮、海、瀆、農、蠶、風、雷、雨師之祀。

translations.literal: Day renshen: ritual officials were ordered to list sacrifices to Literary King, Martial King, Spark Star, Longevity Star, peaks, rivers, sea, agriculture, silkworms, wind, thunder, and rain lords.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, ritual officials listed Literary King, Martial King, Spark, Longevity, peaks, rivers, sea, farming, silkworms, wind, thunder, and rain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以胡安國提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀，趣赴行在，未至而罷。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Hu An'guo was made Wanshou Abbey commissioner with concurrent Lecturer and urged to court; before he arrived he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Hu An'guo became Wanshou commissioner and Lecturer and was summoned; he was dismissed before arrival.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以酈瓊為行營左護軍副都統制。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Li Qiong was made Left Guard deputy overall commander of the campaign camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Qiong became Left Guard deputy overall commander.

sentences.zh: 甲申，初試樞密院都督府效士。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Privy Council and Overall Command staff scholars were first examined.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Privy Council and Overall Command scholars were first examined.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命侍從官通舉材堪知縣者二十人。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: attendant officials were ordered jointly to recommend twenty men fit for county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, attendants jointly recommended twenty men fit for county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，偽齊陷隨州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: puppet Qi took Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, puppet Qi took Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禁四川增印錢引。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Sichuan was forbidden to print extra money notes.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Sichuan was forbidden extra printing of money notes.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，改上惠恭皇后諡曰顯恭皇后。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinmao new moon: the departed Empress Hui-Gong's posthumous title was changed to Illustrious Respect Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinmao new moon: the late Empress Hui-Gong was renamed Illustrious Respect Empress.

sentences.zh: 岳飛入見。

translations.literal: Yue Fei had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei was received at court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命歲辰戌月祀大火，配以閼伯。

translations.literal: Day renchen: yearly in chen and xu months the Great Fire was sacrificed to, with Yan Bo as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, chen and xu months each year were to sacrifice to the Great Fire with Yan Bo as associate.

sentences.zh: 乙未，罷江、淮營田司，令諸路安撫、轉運司兼領其事。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Jiang-Huai garrison-farm office was abolished; every route's pacification and transport commissioners were ordered to take charge jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Jiang-Huai garrison-farm office was cut; each route's pacification and transport commissioners were to run it together.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以《重修神宗實錄》去取未當，命史館復加考訂。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: because selections in the Revised Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong were improper, the History Office was ordered to revise again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the Revised Shenzong Veritable Records were found ill-chosen; the History Office was told to revise again.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，岳飛引過自劾，詔放罪，慰諭之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Yue Fei cited faults and memorialized self-impeachment; an edict pardoned and comforted him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Yue Fei confessed fault and impeached himself; the throne pardoned and soothed him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命劉錡兼都督府諮議軍事，率兵戍廬州。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Liu Qi was ordered concurrently as Overall Command consultation military affairs officer and to lead troops to garrison Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Liu Qi was made Overall Command consultation officer and marched to garrison Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，沈與求薨。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Shen Yuqiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Shen Yuqiu died.

sentences.zh: 召王德以所部兵赴行在。

translations.literal: Wang De was summoned with his division to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Wang De was recalled with his troops to court.

sentences.zh: 遣呂祉如淮西撫諭諸軍。

translations.literal: Lü Zhi was sent to Huai west to reassure the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Zhi was sent to soothe the Huai-west armies.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔吳玠、李迨共議四川經費，贍軍恤民。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: an edict ordered Wu Jie and Li Dai jointly to deliberate Sichuan expenses and support the army while soothing the people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Wu Jie and Li Dai were told to set Sichuan spending together and feed the armies while easing the people.

sentences.zh: 岳飛復職。

translations.literal: Yue Fei resumed office.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei returned to office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，詔侍從各舉可任監司、郡守者一二人。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen: an edict ordered each palace attendant to recommend one or two men fit for circuit intendant or prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuchen: each palace attendant was to name one or two men fit for intendant or prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以旱，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: because of drought, prayer was made at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, drought brought prayer at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，嗣濮王仲湜薨。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Heir Prince of Pu Zhongchi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Heir Prince of Pu Zhongchi died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以久旱，命中外臣庶實封言事。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: because of prolonged drought, officials and commoners within and without were ordered to submit sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, after long drought, court and country were called to file sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 甲申，蠲諸路民積年逋租。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: accumulated rent arrears of the people on every route were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, every route's accumulated rent arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 以建康疫盛，遣醫行視，貧民給錢，葬其死者。

translations.literal: Because plague was severe at Jiankang, doctors were sent on inspection tours; the poor were given cash and the dead buried.
translations.idiomatic: Plague raged at Jiankang; physicians were sent out, the poor were paid, and the dead were buried.

sentences.zh: 命疏決滯獄。

translations.literal: An order was given to clear backlog prisons.
translations.idiomatic: Backlogged prisons were ordered cleared.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔即建康權正社稷之位。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict provisionally set the altars of soil and grain at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the altars of soil and grain were provisionally set at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔戶部長貳迭出巡按諸路，考究財賦利病，違者劾之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: an edict ordered Revenue vice ministers to rotate in touring routes, examine fiscal gain and loss, and impeach offenders.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Revenue vice ministers were to rotate through the routes, audit fiscal health, and impeach abuses.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔諸路歸業民墾田，及八年始輸全稅。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict said people returning to reclaim fields paid full tax only after eight years.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, returned cultivators paid full tax only after eight years on the land.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，以張俊為淮西宣撫使，駐盱眙；

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: Zhang Jun was made Huai-west pacification commissioner and stationed at Xuyi;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yiwei: Zhang Jun became Huai-west pacification commissioner at Xuyi;

sentences.zh: 楊沂中為淮西制置使，主管侍衛馬軍司劉錡副之，並駐廬州。

translations.literal: Yang Yizhong was made Huai-west disposition commissioner; Steward of the Palace Horse Army Liu Qi was his deputy; both were stationed at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yizhong became Huai-west disposition commissioner; palace horse steward Liu Qi was his deputy; both camped at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 命酈瓊率兵赴行在。

translations.literal: Li Qiong was ordered to lead troops to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiong was ordered to court with his troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，瓊叛，殺中軍統制張景等，執呂祉及趙康直、趙不群，以兵四萬人奔劉豫。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Qiong rebelled, killed middle-army controller Zhang Jing and others, seized Lü Zhi, Zhao Kangzhi, and Zhao Buqun, and with forty thousand troops fled to Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Qiong rebelled, killed Zhang Jing and other middle-army controllers, seized Lü Zhi, Zhao Kangzhi, and Zhao Buqun, and with forty thousand men went over to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，手詔赦廬州屯駐行營左護軍。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: a handwritten edict amnestied the mobile-court Left Guard Army garrisoned at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, a handwritten edict amnestied the Left Guard Army at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，酈瓊引兵至淮，殺祉及康直，釋不群，使還。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Qiong led troops to the Huai, killed Zhi and Kangzhi, released Buqun, and sent him back.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Qiong reached the Huai, killed Zhi and Kangzhi, freed Buqun, and sent him home.

sentences.zh: 劉錡、吳錫至廬州，以兵追之不及，命張宗元往招之。

translations.literal: Liu Qi and Wu Xi reached Luzhou and pursued with troops but could not overtake him; Zhang Zongyuan was ordered to go recruit him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi and Wu Xi reached Luzhou and gave chase but missed him; Zhang Zongyuan was sent to win him back.

sentences.zh: 張浚乞去位。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun begged to leave office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun asked to resign.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以趙鼎為萬壽觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zhao Ding was made director of Wanshou Temple and lecture companion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhao Ding became director of Wanshou Temple and lecture companion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔命官犯贓，刑部不得擅黥配，聽朝廷裁斷。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: an edict said when appointed officials committed bribery, the Ministry of Justice might not on its own tattoo and exile them—the court was to decide.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, bribery by appointed men could not be tattooed and exiled by Justice alone; the court would judge.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜岳飛軍錢十萬緡。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Yue Fei was given one hundred thousand strings of military pay.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yue Fei was given one hundred thousand strings of military cash.

sentences.zh: 招歸正復業人耕湖北、京西閒田。

translations.literal: Returned defectors who resumed livelihood were recruited to farm idle fields between Hubei and Jing west.
translations.idiomatic: Returned defectors were settled to farm idle land between Hubei and Jing west.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，上太上皇帝諡曰聖文仁德顯孝皇帝，廟號徽宗，皇后曰顯肅皇后。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: the retired emperor's posthumous title was Sagely Literary, Benevolent, Virtuous, and Filially Illustrious Emperor, temple name Huizong; the empress was Illustrious Solemn Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiazi: the retired emperor was styled Sagely Literary, Benevolent, Virtuous, and Filially Illustrious, temple name Huizong; the empress Illustrious Solemn.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，韓世忠、張俊入見，乃命俊自盱眙移屯廬州。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun had audience; Jun was then ordered to move his camp from Xuyi to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun were received; Jun was told to shift from Xuyi to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，張浚罷。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Zhang Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhang Jun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命參知政事輪日當筆，權三省事，更不分治常程。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: participation-in-governance officials were ordered to take daily turns at the brush and jointly handle Three Departments affairs, no longer splitting routine business.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, participation officials were to rotate the brush daily and run the Three Departments together, not split routine work.

sentences.zh: 罷都督府。

translations.literal: The Overall Command was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Overall Command was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以台諫累疏，落張浚觀文殿大學士，仍領宮祠。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: because censorial offices repeatedly memorialized, Zhang Jun was stripped of Wenzheng Hall grand academician and kept only temple service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, after repeated censorial memorials, Zhang Jun lost Wenzheng Hall grand academician and kept only a temple sinecure.

sentences.zh: 丙子，復以趙鼎為尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Zhao Ding was again made Left Vice Premier, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and concurrent Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Zhao Ding was again Left Vice Premier, Secretariat-Chancellery grand councilor, and Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以廬州、壽春府民遭酈瓊虜掠，蠲租稅一年。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: because the people of Luzhou and Shouchun prefecture had suffered Li Qiong's plunder, taxes were remitted one year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Luzhou and Shouchun, ravaged by Li Qiong, had taxes remitted one year.

sentences.zh: 己卯，朝獻聖祖于常朝殿。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Sacred Ancestor was offered to at the Ever-Audience Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Sacred Ancestor was offered to at the Ever-Audience Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Grand Ancestral Temple was offered to.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the court offered at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Mingtang; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the Mingtang and a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 召劉光世赴行在。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁諸路進羨餘。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: every route was forbidden to submit surplus tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, routes were forbidden to send surplus tribute.

sentences.zh: 以劉錡知廬州兼淮西制置副使。

translations.literal: Liu Qi was made magistrate of Luzhou and concurrent Huai-west disposition deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi became Luzhou magistrate and Huai-west disposition deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅朔，詔仍舊開經筵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengyin new moon: an edict restored the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengyin new moon: the classics lecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命後省官看詳上書有可采者，條上行之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: rear secretariat officers were ordered to review submitted memorials for adoptable points and memorialize them upward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, rear secretariat men were to sift submitted memorials for usable points and report up.

sentences.zh: 丁酉夜，敕張浚安置嶺表。

translations.literal: On dingyou night, an edict banished Zhang Jun to the Lingnan region.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou night, Zhang Jun was banished to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，趙鼎累請浚母老，改永州居住。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Zhao Ding repeatedly begged on account of Jun's aged mother; he was changed to residence at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhao Ding pleaded for Jun's aged mother; Jun was moved to residence at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 偽齊犯泗州，守臣劉綱擊走之。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi invaded Sizhou; defender Liu Gang struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi struck Sizhou; defender Liu Gang beat them back.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命戶部郎官薛弼、霍蠡同總領江西、湖、廣五路財賦。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Revenue bureau officers Xue Bi and Huo Li were ordered jointly to oversee finances of Jiangxi and the five routes of Hunan and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xue Bi and Huo Li of Revenue were told jointly to run Jiangxi and the five Hunan-Guang routes' finances.

sentences.zh: 壬子，統制呼延通、王權等襲擊金人于淮陽軍，敗之，丁巳，詔六參日，輪行在百官一員轉對。

translations.literal: Day renzi: controllers Huyan Tong and Wang Quan and others raided Jin troops at Huaiyang army and routed them; day dingsi: an edict on six-participation days ordered one mobile-court official to rotate in presenting policy.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Huyan Tong, Wang Quan, and others ambushed the Jin at Huaiyang army and broke them; on dingsi, six-participation days were set for one court officer to rotate policy memorials.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸亥，贈趙康直徽猷閣待制。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiazi: Zhao Kangzhi was posthumously made Xuanyou Pavilion attendant-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jiazi: Zhao Kangzhi was posthumously made Xuanyou Pavilion attendant.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，蠲江東路月樁錢萬緡。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Jiangdong route's monthly pile money of ten thousand strings was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Jiangdong's ten-thousand-string monthly pile levy was cut.

sentences.zh: 發米二萬石振京西、湖北饑民。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand shi of grain were issued to relieve famine in Jing west and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand shi of grain went to relieve Jing west and Hubei famine.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，尹焞入見，命為秘書郎兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Yin Tun had audience and was made Secretariat gentleman and Chongzheng Hall lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Yin Tun was received and made Secretariat gentleman and Chongzheng Hall lecturer.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，始作徽宗皇帝、顯肅皇后神主。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: spirit tablets for Emperor Huizong and Illustrious Solemn Empress were first made.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, tablets for Huizong and the Illustrious Solemn Empress were first made.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，韓世忠引兵渡淮，逆擊金人于劉冷莊，敗之。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Han Shizhong led troops across the Huai and met Jin troops at Liuleng village and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Han Shizhong crossed the Huai, met the Jin at Liuleng village, and broke them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李綱罷。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Li Gang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Li Gang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復漢陽軍。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Hanyang army was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Hanyang army was restored.

sentences.zh: 是月，張俊棄盱眙，引兵還建康。

translations.literal: That month Zhang Jun abandoned Xuyi and led troops back to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Jun left Xuyi and withdrew to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，賜吳玠犒軍錢百五十萬緡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: Wu Jie was given one million five hundred thousand strings of troop comfort money.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingchen: Wu Jie was given one million five hundred thousand strings to comfort the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以知溫州李光為江西安撫制置大使。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Wenzhou magistrate Li Guang was made Jiangxi pacification and disposition grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Li Guang of Wenzhou became Jiangxi pacification and disposition grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金帥撻懶、兀朮入汴京，執偽齊劉豫，廢為蜀王。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Jin commanders Tadalan and Wuzhu entered Bianjing, seized puppet Qi's Liu Yu, and demoted him to Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Tadalan and Wuzhu entered Bianjing, took Liu Yu of puppet Qi, and demoted him to Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔來春復幸浙西。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict said the court would again visit western Zhe in the coming spring.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the throne said it would tour western Zhe again next spring.

sentences.zh: 是月，偽齊知臨汝軍崔虎詣岳飛降。

translations.literal: That month puppet Qi's Linru army defender Cui Hu came to Yue Fei to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month Cui Hu of puppet Qi's Linru army surrendered to Yue Fei.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，復置都大提舉四川茶馬監牧官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengchen: the grand intendant of Sichuan tea, horses, and herds was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengchen: the grand Sichuan tea-horse-and-herd intendant was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，祔徽宗皇帝、顯肅皇后神主于太廟。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the spirit tablets of Emperor Huizong and Illustrious Solemn Empress were enshrined in the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Huizong's and the Illustrious Solemn Empress's tablets were enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以解潛權主管馬步軍司，命韓世忠留屯楚州，遮罩江、淮。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Xie Qian was made acting head of the horse-and-foot army office; Han Shizhong was ordered to remain at Chuzhou screening the Yangtze and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xie Qian was acting head of horse and foot; Han Shizhong was told to hold Chuzhou and screen the river lines.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔內外大將及侍從官，舉武臣智略器局堪帥守謀議官者。

translations.literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered grand generals within and without and palace attendants to recommend military men of strategy and bearing fit for command, defense, or policy posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, grand generals and attendants were to name soldiers of mind and mettle fit to command, defend, or counsel.

sentences.zh: 癸未，王倫等使還，入見，言金國許還梓宮及皇太后，又許還河南諸州。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Wang Lun and other envoys returned and had audience; they said the Jin state would return the imperial coffin and empress dowager and also restore Henan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Wang Lun's mission returned; they reported the Jin would send back the coffin and empress dowager and restore Henan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲申，城泗州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: walls at Sizhou were built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Sizhou's walls were built.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復遣王倫等奉迎梓宮。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wang Lun and others were again sent to welcome the imperial coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wang Lun and others were sent again to welcome the coffin.

sentences.zh: 是冬，吳玠遣裨將馬希仲攻熙州，鄭宗、李進攻鞏州，不克，宗死於城下，希仲遁還，玠斬以徇。

translations.literal: That winter Wu Jie sent subordinate Ma Xizhong to attack Xi prefecture; Zheng Zong and Li Jin attacked Gong prefecture but could not take it; Zong died below the wall; Xizhong fled back; Jie executed him as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Wu Jie sent Ma Xizhong against Xi; Zheng Zong and Li Jin struck Gong and failed; Zong fell below the wall; Xizhong fled; Jie beheaded him before the ranks.
